about_the_game:
Texas, 1975. He only kills parents. He leaves the children alive. And now he’s waiting for you.

You play as Weldon McCall, a former Dallas homicide detective who thought he’d left his ghosts behind. Now working as a sheriff in the quiet fields of Emsdorf County, Weldon finds himself drawn back into a nightmare he thought was over.

The killer he failed to stop in Dallas has returned — and this time, he’s closer than ever. Families are dying, the brutal crime scenes are back and the children are left alive to carry the memory. The locals feel it in their bones, something is wrong on this street. Weldon will not rest until he has closed this wicked chapter, 

You’ll go door to door, speak with suspicious neighbours and locate the killer. before he locates Weldon and his family... 

WELCOME TO EMSDORF COUNTY 

At its core, Have You Seen This Man? is about walking the streets, knocking on doors, and talking to the people who live here. Every encounter feels different — from conspiracy cranks rambling about government plots to rednecks with shotguns and bad intentions. Some might help you, some might lie to your face, but all of them pull you deeper into the story of a county that doesn’t quite add up.

GAMEPLAY

In this opening chapter from Cosmic Sabbath, You play as Weldon McCall, a former Dallas homicide detective who thought he’d left his ghosts behind. Now working as a sheriff in the quiet fields of Emsdorf County, Weldon finds himself drawn back into a nightmare he thought was over.

The killer he failed to stop in Dallas has returned and this time, he’s closer than ever. Families are dying, the brutal crime scenes are back and the children are left alive to carry the memory. The locals feel it in their bones, something is wrong on this street. Weldon will not rest until he has ends this wicked nightmare, once and for all. 

You’ll go door to door, speak with suspicious neighbours and locate the killer... before he locates Weldon and his family... 

This game is primarily a first-person narrative horror walking simulator, centred on a unique story, character interactions where exploration and conversation drive a grounded tale of horror.

AMERICAN HELL - THE FUTURE 

American Hell is Cosmic Sabbath’s long-form horror anthology, a collection of stories set across different decades and places in America. Each entry stands alone, but together they build a larger world of violence, paranoia and survival.

Have You Seen This Man? is only the beginning. Emsdorf County marks the first descent into American Hell,  a new horror franchise we’ll return to with new stories, new characters and new nightmares for you too enjoy. 

Follow Cosmic Sabbath as we expand the anthology and uncover more horrors waiting in the dark corners of America.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature themes, strong language, and intense sequences that some players may find disturbing. Viewer discretion is advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent (4 cores)
  • Memory: 8 GB GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 (or GTX 750 Ti) / AMD Radeon R7 370 or equivalent with ~2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB free SSD or fast HDD GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX compatible sound device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or bette
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: SSD with ~10 GB free GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX compatible sound device
